summary: probe_luna.py first runs rejected by OpenAI API: max_tokens unsupported (use max_completion_tokens) and temperature=0 unsupported (only default 1 allowed) for gpt-5.6-luna. Fixed by switching to max_completion_tokens and removing temperature. Probe then succeeded.
root_cause: gpt-5.6-luna has nonstandard chat-completions surface vs typical OpenAI models (no max_tokens, temperature pinned to default). Assumed standard params instead of reading the error first.
